findings.detail: AP Highlands Holdings and AP Highlands Co-Invest are unsecured notes whose source interest rate is 9.75%, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.
Accordion Partners Holdings LLC is an unsecured note whose source interest rate is 12.75% PIK, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.
ACC Ultimate Holdings, L.P. is source-classified as Equity, so the PRIVATE_CREDIT missing-rate warning is caused by classification rather than a missing debt coupon.

rationale: The X02 issue is real. For debt rows, the filing schedule contains explicit interest-rate cells that the extracted holdings left blank, including AP Highlands at 9.75% and Accordion Partners Holdings at 12.75% PIK. The source also shows ACC Ultimate Holdings as Equity, while the flagged artifact treats its blank-rate row as PRIVATE_CREDIT. These source rows ground both the missing-rate extraction gap and the classification defect.
